comment: The zoom of the terminal window (D-384): three steps, 115 by default. Ctrl+= and Ctrl+- move one step and stop at the ends, Ctrl+0 goes back to the default. A value from the settings file that is not a step reads as the default. The terminal gets its font in whole points: the nearest to the text of the window, 13 units times the zoom, at 96 units in an inch and 72 points.
